stories.title: Kroger stock at USD 59.94 on September 28, 2026
stories.summary: Kroger's stock was trading at USD 59.94 on September 28, 2026, marking a 2.04 percent increase. The company recently released its second-quarter results, showing sales growth to USD 34.6 billion, but subsequently lowered its full-year identical-sales outlook for 2026. Despite the revised sales guidance, Kroger reaffirmed its profit and adjusted earnings per share outlook.
